findings.where: svg.chart x5 (NRR bars, plan donut, 3 region sparklines)
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json records no name, role or title on any svg.chart; the weekly bar values and region trends exist only as drawing, with no table or text equivalent (the sparklines' percentages are given, the bars' values are not).
findings.after: role="img" aria-label="Net recurring revenue by week, weeks 21-27: ..." on each chart, or a visually hidden <table> of the weekly values
findings.title: Images have text alternatives
findings.fix: Write what the image tells the reader, or alt="" if it tells nothing.

findings.where: bar chart (hero), plan donut, region sparklines
findings.evidence: T-GRAYSCALE: the partial week is distinguished only by orange vs blue; donut segments by hue only (legend dots); region lines by hue only (blue, orange, violet). Status badges do carry text ('Healthy', 'At risk', 'Churning'), which passes.
findings.after: Add a pattern or outline to the partial bar plus a direct label 'Wk 27 (partial)'; label donut segments in place
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.1 Use of Color and 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast.
findings.title: Text contrast on real pixels
findings.fix: Darken text or lighten ground; never thin weights on tinted ground.

findings.where: hero card 'NET RECURRING REVENUE', bar chart
findings.evidence: Caption says 'Week 27 is the current, partial week.' yet the orange week-27 bar is the tallest of seven; a partial week out-earning every full week is implausible and the chart has no y-axis values to check it. Failed T-THREE-LINE (not falsifiable from the chart).
findings.before: Unlabelled 7-bar chart, partial week tallest and highlighted orange
findings.after: Show week-27 as a hatched or outlined partial bar at its real (lower) value with axis ticks; [DATA NEEDED: weekly NRR values]
findings.why: Placeholder data that contradicts its own caption reads as invented.
findings.title: No invented metrics
findings.fix: Use the real number, a visible [DATA NEEDED] slot, or nothing.

findings.evidence: Order is sidebar nav + search/avatar bar > hero KPI with bar chart > KPI stack (NRR, churn, pipeline) > donut 'Revenue by plan' > ranked bars 'Largest accounts' > sparklines 'Expansion by region' > sortable table > activity feed. Failed T-DEFAULT-AGENT and T-MIRROR: every block is the stock admin-dashboard kit and would be generated for any B2B revenue console.
findings.before: Bento of KPI cards, donut, ranking, sparklines, table, feed
findings.after: Pick the one question this console answers first (e.g. which renewals are at risk this month) and let that block lead; demote or drop panels that do not serve it
findings.why: A dashboard that shows every chart type once is a decorative dashboard, not an answer.
findings.title: Never ship decorative dashboards: donut walls, gauge rows, KPI confetti
Target size
findings.fix: Enlarge the hit area with padding or a pseudo-element.
